card.name: Small numbers before fold or weeks
card.fires_on: Small number words or digits (two, three, five, 3, 4) right before a counting unit such as -fold, weeks, months or cycles. Mostly in drug interaction and dosing schedule text.

modes.description: A digit or number word giving an interval or duration, before weeks, months or cycles.

card.writes: It favors words that continue a count, such as several, fold, dozens and four, and disfavors Chinese measure words.
card.plain: It fires on a small number that is about to be followed by a unit like fold, weeks or months.
